explanation: Eta electroproduction (ep -> e' p eta) threshold is W ≈ M_p + m_eta ≈ 0.938 + 0.547 = 1.485 GeV. The ETA-channel EXCLURAD grid (EtaMAID-2023) starts at W = 1.4856 GeV (mpintp.inc NVAR2 minimum). Requested W = 1.45 GeV is sub-threshold and physically impossible. Being above the Delta (≈1.23 GeV) does not make eta production allowed. No input file can be run; correction is other than fixing a parameter — the kinematics are impossible.
